Aurendale is a picturesque island nation located in the Serenith Ocean, roughly between the Kingdom of Khopda & Chikhanbaatar Khanate. Known for its lush landscapes and technologically advanced cities, Aurendale has become a hub for innovative sustainable technologies, specifically those related to renewable energy. Its capital, Eolus City, is powered entirely by Wind, Solar Energy, & Nuclear Power. Its economy is heavily reliant on the exports of high-tech products, pharmaceuticals, and its world-renowned Aurendalian whiskey. The official language is Aurendalian, but many residents are bilingual, with Aurendalian Gaelic being the second most spoken language.

= Politics =
Aurendale is a democratic socialist republic, characterized by a strong commitment to social justice, equality, and democratic principles. The head of government is the Prime Minister, who is elected by the citizens of Aurendale and heads the government. Aurendale's Parliament consists of the National Assembly and the Senate. The National Assembly members are directly elected by citizens, while the Senate is chosen by the National Assembly from a pool of nominees. The party or coalition with the majority in the National Assembly forms the government.
